alfheimmisc.scam3: %sIt's good to have beginner's luck. It's bad that you don't look like a beginner.
alfheimmisc.scam4: %sSomeone went up to the floating island. Someone found the treasure. That someone is not you.
alfheimmisc.scam5: %sLet me guess, someone stole your sweetroll? Look somewhere else!
alfheimmisc.scam6: %sAnd that's it, it's too late! The dark elves took it all out before you did.
alfheimmisc.scam7: %sSo why are you staring? Never talked to the air?
alfheimmisc.scam8: %sThere's nothing at all here. Try searching for treasure in the anomalies.
alfheimmisc.scam9: %sShh! Something's rolling... Ah, it's you who's away from here.
alfheimmisc.scam10: %sWhat are you, crazy? Why disintegrate me from space at once?
alfheimmisc.scam11: %sWash your hands first, then paw me!
alfheimmisc.scam12: %sAren't you afraid of touching strange, obscure boxes? I was just asking...
alfheimmisc.scam13: %sI've never seen anyone like you. I hope it stays that way.
alfheimmisc.scam14: %sYou are unique! Our world can't take two of those.
alfheimmisc.scam15: %sWhat a shame that you're finally leaving.
alfheimmisc.scam16: %sAnd you're quite handsome. There's something in common with a Lolicorn.
alfheimmisc.scam17: %sGood to see you, adventurer! I hope it doesn't last too long.
alfheimmisc.scam18: %sWhat a surprise! I don't like surprises.
alfheimmisc.scam19: %sCan you not look at me with such puzzlement? I can almost hear the buzz in your empty head.
alfheimmisc.scam20: %sWow, you are so skilled! Just a fully undeveloped individual.
alfheimmisc.scam21: %sI would give you everything, but unfortunately, I haven't taken anything from anyone yet.
alfheimmisc.scam22: %sDon't steal the treasure. That's the job of the other pointed-eared ones.
alfheimmisc.scam23: %sIn an elimination game, you're sure to win!
alfheimmisc.scam24: %sWhat a pity you're not a treasure... I can't bury you.
alfheimmisc.scam25: %sAsinus Stultissimus! Ah, you don't get it... I said you're pretty good-looking.
alfheimmisc.scam26: %sAtangolmo na laiwave! Oh, there's nothing special here. I merely admire your cleverness.
alfheimmisc.scam27: %sDu machst mich krank! I say you're always welcome.

charades.question1: <Vafþrúðnir> Then there were no abodes of mortals, no issued laws, no huts and no palaces, no jarls and no slaves. Only two who announced everything. Light and darkness, wildness and silence, flame and fog. What am I talking about?
charades.question2: <Vafþrúðnir> There is no earth and heaven, no sea and forest. No Sun and Moon, no death and immortality. There is no born and death, no blesses and no curses. There is nothing. What am I talking about?
charades.question3: <Vafþrúðnir> There were two, a wife in the north and a husband in the south. The wife wanted to be the master of the marriage, but the husband fought fiercely. They fought, they hated each other, but only in this way they gave birth to an offspring. Whom am I talking about?
charades.question4: <Vafþrúðnir> That was the first sacrifice, the first trick. The younger ones rebelled against the older ones. Order seized upon chaos and cut it apart. What am I talking about?
charades.question5: <Vafþrúðnir> All roads lead to a place across the river. Wherever you go, you will go there in due time. If the small dream is not conquered, then who will conquer the great dream? ... We'll all be in the boat, you can't run away. What am I talking about?
charades.question6: <Vafþrúðnir> The ancients say that what does not fight, does not kill and does not curse ... once poisoned the minds of many of the killers of eternity, they began to fight, kill and curse everything from the sky to the sun in the night. What am I talking about?
charades.question7: <Vafþrúðnir> Born in the forest of iron, brother of the mistress of the dead, is the one about whom the prophetess said: the scourge of the gods, bringing death, he will devour all light. He was bound by something that no longer exists in the universe, he was deceived, the retribution was cruel. Whom am I talking about?
charades.answer28: %s) Tangible world creation from Ymir body
charades.final1: <%s> Tell me, o the wise one, is there any way to prevent the destruction of the worlds that are swallowed up by the abyss?
charades.final2: <Vafþrúðnir> The Anchor of Reality will be the answer.
charades.final3: <%s> Tell me, o the wise one, how can we completely stop the ferocity of the forces of the abyss and heal the worlds?
charades.final4: <Vafþrúðnir> A cosmogonic act in miniature can help you.
charades.final5: <%s>Tell me, o the wise one, where to seek forgiveness for fools who, through their naivety, have succumbed to the influence of the abyss?
charades.final6: <Vafþrúðnir> Sincere repentance can cause the gods to show mercy to the servants of the abyss. Otherwise, may the blood wash away their sins when they fall at the hands of the servants of the gods.
charades.started: <Vafþrúðnir> Greetings, seeker of wisdom. Prove that you are worthy by answering my questions. You have a minute to think.
charades.failed: <Vafþrúðnir> Your knowledge is too meager to be called wise. Get out of my sight!
charades.completed: <Vafþrúðnir> You showed decent results and got answers to your questions. I will write them down for you. Now let me ease your pain...

alfheim.tagline.HV: The best way to spend your vacation
alfheim.page.HV0: Everyone loves to eat watermelons, and they are especially eaten during the hot summer, sitting on the veranda of your house or relaxing with friends on the beach. But the watermelons themselves are not delighted with such a rate of eating their congeners. Taking advantage of magical powers, they will try to escape from your garden.
alfheim.page.HV1: However, summer is not only a time of fun and relaxation, but also a time when the world of fire and flames, &4Muspelheim&0, is temporarily moving closer to the rest of the worlds as it descends from its place after the Shattering. Because of this, the flame is able to penetrate into other worlds.
alfheim.page.HV2: The favorite delicacy of the fire spirits living in Muspelheim are also melons, but not water ones, but lavamelons, into which ordinary watermelons can occasionally turn, being saturated with the energy of fire instead of water. If you offer them even more fiery energy, it is possible to make a deal with them.
alfheim.page.HV3: Place the &1Block of Muspelheim Power&0 in the floor of the flat area and place a piece of &1Lavamelon&0 on it. Using &1Yordin Pylons&0 placed around the perimeter, fire spirits will come to the feast. However, other Muspelheim residents may follow them, so be careful and protect fire spirits. They will reward you after.
alfheim.page.HV4:
&oSometimes you may be unlucky and Greater Fire Spirit will turn out to be a masochist. Then, in order for it to do something, it will need to be hurt. Just don't kill it...&0



&oIt's not a bug, it's a feature&0
alfheim.page.WOTW0: Winter ... On the one hand, this is a wonderful time for frosty adventures, games in the snow and creative buildings of ice, but on the other, a snowstorm hiding all kinds of trails and houses, a formidable storm and severe frosts.
alfheim.page.WOTW1: Perhaps everyone, whether a human or an elf, at least once in his life sculpted a snowman, although among elves it is more like a snowball with wings (in honor of the spirits of festive colds). And only a few experienced adventurers, in whom the spirit of the New Year is still left, dream to fight and, possibly, even overcome a severe frost.
alfheim.page.WOTW2: Unfortunately, all tales and stories about unprecedented snow warriors do not inspire confidence in anyone but children. Although, who knows - the wrath of the winter may fall on anyone who neglects reverence for the creatures of the cold - the snow sprites.
